data.description: Your melee touch attack deals 1d6 points of nonlethal cold damage + 1 point per level, and the target is fatigued. The fatigued condition ends when the target recovers from the nonlethal damage. This spell cannot make a creature exhausted even if it is already fatigued. You can use this melee touch attack up to one time per level.

raw_tokens.value: Target takes 1d6+(CASTERLEVEL) nonlethal cold damage and is fatigued.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
